messages:
violet: Follow-up from the sync — proposing "sideload-v2" resume rules so we have deterministic behavior across gateway failover and model rollouts. Capturing key decision points.

ben: TL;DR?

violet: Goals: keep gateway memory bounded for long streaming responses, allow safe client resume, and make retries deterministic when possible. Rough approach: resume-token includes upstream-digest + model-version + prompt-hash + offset; edge only auto-resumes if upstream-digest matches. Otherwise return 410/resumable.

zane: How strict is the digest match? If model got a minor patch we might still be able to resume safely for some workloads.

violet: We considered a compatibility table (exact match, minor-compatible, incompatible). For P1 we require exact upstream-digest match. P2 we can add opt-in relaxed resume where upstream publishes a compatibility vector.

ben: What about partial-results already persisted? If edge has chunks committed to storage, can we serve them even when digest mismatches?

violet: Yes — edge will serve already-persisted chunks (read-only) irrespective of digest; but auto-resume to produce new chunks requires match. If digest mismatches we send 410 + X-Edge-Reason: digest-mismatch and include safe fallback guidance.

infra-bot: Operational notes: presigned one-time upload URLs for chunking, store content-md5, verify on finalize. Short TTL on resume tokens (default 10m) and enforce tenant-scoped quotas. Encrypt-at-rest when tenant KMS requested.

devx: SDK UX: can you provide the minimal flow so we can add helpers?

violet: Example (pseudocode):
```
Start -> POST /v1/generate (X-Sideloader: true)
Edge -> 200 OK + X-Resumable-Token: rtk:eyJ...
Stream frames: {"chunk_id":"c1","seq":0,"size":120000,"url":"..."}
If resume: Client -> POST /v1/resume (X-Resumable-Token: rtk..., Offset: 240000)
Edge -> 206 Partial Content (replays persisted chunks then optionally resumes upstream if digest ok)
```

zane: Config defaults suggestion: inline_buffer=64KB, offload_threshold=256KB, max_sideloads_per_tenant=6, token_ttl=600s. Also global_node_sideload_limit to protect object egress.

ben: Action items:
- ben -> draft RFC update with token format & error codes (today)
- infra -> presigned URL + md5 verify spike (1w)
- devx -> SDK helper sketch + error mapping (this sprint)

violet: OK will fold these in. If no objections I'll land RFC patch by EOD tomorrow.

devx: lgtm :thumbsup:
